[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25789](The helmet is from my other mod)[/url]﻿

[size=5]FAQ[/size]
[b]How to get the hand mirror?[/b]
- On the current version used for this mod in Fashion Sense 6.6.0, you either check the box [Start with mirror] at the start of a new save file
and check your mailbox [i]or  [/i]buy it at Pierre the mod also says to use the console command fs_add_mirror to force it into your inventory but i haven't tried this.

[b]How to contact me?[/b]
